name: Advanced Filesystem: Upload Directory
description: Routes file/image field uploads to a configured destination directory at entity save time, with per-field rules, a global fallback, Drupal-token support in the path, and an admin file browser. Sub-module of Advanced Filesystem.
project_description: The Upload Directory sub-module of Advanced Filesystem controls where files uploaded through file/image fields are stored. Instead of the field's own directory, an UploadDirectoryManager runs on hook_entity_insert()/hook_entity_update(), iterates every file/image field on the saved content entity, resolves the target directory (first matching enabled per-field rule for entity_type+bundle+field, else a global fallback), resolves Drupal tokens in that directory against the entity, optionally creates the directory, and moves each file there with FileRepository::move(). Directory values are stream-wrapper URIs (public://, private:// or any writable wrapper) and may embed tokens such as [date:year] or a content field. A settings form builds per-field rules with cascading entity-type/bundle/field dropdowns and a scheme+path directory picker with a live token preview; a file-browser controller lists the files currently inside each configured directory, filterable by stream-wrapper scheme. Configuration is gated by the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_upload_directory' permission.
